WITH scoped AS ( SELECT c.id, (c.registered_at AT TIME ZONE #{q.timezone})::date AS reg_day FROM customers c WHERE c.status <> 'DELETED' ), visits AS ( SELECT s.customer_id, max(s.local_date) AS last_day FROM stamps s WHERE s.status = 'CONFIRMED' GROUP BY s.customer_id ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM scoped) AS total, (SELECT count(*) FROM visits WHERE last_day > #{today}::date - 7) AS active7, (SELECT count(*) FROM visits WHERE last_day > #{today}::date - 30) AS active30, (SELECT count(*) FROM visits WHERE last_day > #{today}::date - 90) AS active90, (SELECT count(*) FROM scoped WHERE reg_day >= #{weekStart}) AS new_week, (SELECT count(*) FROM scoped WHERE reg_day >= #{monthStart}) AS new_month, (SELECT count(*) FROM scoped WHERE reg_day BETWEEN #{q.from} AND #{q.to}) AS new_period, (SELECT count(*) FROM stamps s WHERE s.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND s.local_date BETWEEN #{q.from} AND #{q.to} ) AS stamps, (SELECT count(*) FROM rewards r WHERE (r.earned_at AT TIME ZONE #{q.timezone})::date BETWEEN #{q.from} AND #{q.to}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stamps s WHERE s.reward_id = r.id AND s.branch_id IN ) ) AS earned, (SELECT count(*) FROM rewards r WHERE r.status = 'REDEEMED' AND (r.redeemed_at AT TIME ZONE #{q.timezone})::date BETWEEN #{q.from} AND #{q.to} AND r.redeemed_branch_id IN ) AS redeemed

WITH buckets AS ( SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('${unit}', CAST(#{q.from} AS date)), CAST(#{q.to} AS date), CAST('1 ${unit}' AS interval))::date AS bucket ), st AS ( SELECT date_trunc('${unit}', s.local_date)::date AS bucket, count(*) AS n FROM stamps s WHERE s.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND s.local_date BETWEEN #{q.from} AND #{q.to}
GROUP BY 1 ), rd AS ( SELECT date_trunc('${unit}', (r.redeemed_at AT TIME ZONE #{q.timezone})::date)::date AS bucket, count(*) AS n FROM rewards r WHERE r.status = 'REDEEMED' AND (r.redeemed_at AT TIME ZONE #{q.timezone})::date BETWEEN #{q.from} AND #{q.to} AND r.redeemed_branch_id IN GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT b.bucket AS date, coalesce(st.n, 0) AS stamps, coalesce(rd.n, 0) AS rewards_redeemed FROM buckets b LEFT JOIN st ON st.bucket = b.bucket LEFT JOIN rd ON rd.bucket = b.bucket ORDER BY b.bucket

SELECT extract(isodow FROM s.created_at AT TIME ZONE #{q.timezone})::int AS day_of_week, extract(hour FROM s.created_at AT TIME ZONE #{q.timezone})::int AS hour, count(*) AS stamps FROM stamps s WHERE s.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND s.local_date BETWEEN #{q.from} AND #{q.to}
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH first_visit AS ( SELECT s.customer_id, min(s.local_date) AS first_day FROM stamps s JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE s.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND (c.registered_at AT TIME ZONE #{q.timezone})::date BETWEEN #{q.from} AND #{q.to} GROUP BY s.customer_id ) SELECT count(*) AS cohort, count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stamps s WHERE s.customer_id = f.customer_id AND s.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND s.local_date > f.first_day AND s.local_date <= f.first_day + 30)) AS returned FROM first_visit f
SELECT c.preferred_language AS language, count(*) AS customers FROM customers c WHERE c.status <> 'DELETED' GROUP BY 1
